decisions.title: Merge NeuraDe into Flowsulting
decisions.context: Running two brands for the same consulting service was splitting attention and confusing positioning
decisions.options: Keep both brands separate, merge into Flowsulting, merge into NeuraDe, create a third brand
decisions.decision: Merge everything under Flowsulting — cleaner, more memorable, broader scope
decisions.expectedOutcome: One strong brand, clearer messaging, faster growth
decisions.actualOutcome: Clean merge completed. All content consolidated. Much simpler to manage.
decisions.lessonsLearned: Two brands for the same service is always a trap. Merge early.

decisions.title: Use JSON file storage for AI OS instead of Supabase
decisions.context: Building the life-system dashboard and choosing data layer. Supabase adds complexity but is production-ready.
decisions.options: Supabase from day one, JSON files with migration later, SQLite, Vercel KV
decisions.decision: Start with JSON files — Claude Code can read/write them directly, fastest to build and iterate
decisions.expectedOutcome: Ship the MVP in days not weeks. Migrate to Supabase when deploying publicly.
decisions.actualOutcome: MVP built fast. Now deploying publicly with demo data.

decisions.title: LinkedIn strategy: pure build-in-public, no selling
decisions.context: Need to grow professional presence but don't want to be seen as pushy or salesy
decisions.options: Mix content + pitches, pure value content, build-in-public only, don't post at all
decisions.decision: Build-in-public only — share what I build, let people come to me
decisions.expectedOutcome: Authentic following that converts naturally when they see the work

decisions.title: Use HeyGen for video avatars instead of recording myself
decisions.context: Need daily video content but can't record every day. AI avatars could automate this.
decisions.options: Record weekly batches, use HeyGen avatars, text-only content, hire a video editor
decisions.decision: HeyGen with Madelyn avatar + automated b-roll pipeline
decisions.expectedOutcome: Daily videos without manual recording. Professional look at scale.
decisions.actualOutcome: Full pipeline running. Daily videos published automatically to YouTube + Slack.
decisions.lessonsLearned: Avatar quality is good enough for news/explainers. Personal face still needed for trust-building content.
